set.acceptance_criteria: A github-actions[bot] compact PR shows required checks invariants and coverage as SUCCESS without a maintainer approving a pull_request workflow, and auto-merge lands a merge commit (two parents). compact.yml and post-merge.yml call associate-pr-checks.sh after dispatch. Lock tests require statuses: write and the script.
set.body: workflow_dispatch of worklog-invariants on a bot branch does run (run 33576637311 SUCCESS on #408). Those check-runs land on the SHA but the PR statusCheckRollup stays empty and mergeStateStatus stays BLOCKED. GITHUB_TOKEN pull_request runs sit action_required (run 33576639595). Posting commit statuses named invariants and coverage made combined status success and #408 merged (MERGE, 2 parents) without approving the pull_request workflow. Dispatch alone is not the unattended path. Do not squash. Do not --admin.
set.title: Bot PR dispatch check-runs do not satisfy required checks

set.resolution: compact.yml and post-merge.yml dispatch worklog-invariants then associate-pr-checks.sh posts commit statuses named invariants and coverage, which is what the PR required-check gate actually sees (#408). statuses: write added. Lock tests cover success, failed job, missing run, missing job.
